hero.h1: New Construction Homes in North Las Vegas
hero.sub: Eighteen new home collections are selling in North Las Vegas right now, from gated townhomes in the low $300,000s to six bedroom homes in the $700,000s. Here is every one I confirmed on a builder's own site, and what to check before you visit a model.

image.alt: Newer two-story homes on a flat subdivision street in North Las Vegas, with more homes still being framed in the background

answer: North Las Vegas is its own city on the north side of the Las Vegas Valley, and most of its new building sits along and north of the 215 Beltway. As of September 16, 2026, builder websites show 18 new home collections selling from three builders: D.R. Horton, KB Home, and Lennar. Most of the detached homes are near Tule Springs, in D.R. Horton's gated Heartland at Tule Springs and KB Home's brand new Sandstone at Tule Springs. Starting prices run from $313,490 for a Lennar townhome at Heritage Square to the $721s for a six bedroom home at Heartland Summit. The one tip: builder pages do not clearly publish HOA or SID amounts, so get both in writing before you sign.
takeaways: The lowest prices are townhomes. Lennar's gated Heritage Square starts at $313,490, and most new homes under $400,000 here are two-story townhomes.
Most detached building is near Tule Springs. D.R. Horton has nine phases selling in Heartland at Tule Springs, and KB Home opened Sandstone at Tule Springs on September 4, 2026.
Single-story costs more. Heartland Grove single-story homes start in the $520s, while a similar size two-story at Heartland Cottages tops out in the $461s.
Clear HOA and SID amounts are not on the builder pages I checked. Ask for the HOA budget in writing and look up the parcel with the Clark County Treasurer.
Phases sell and disappear fast. Two Heartland phase pages have already dropped off D.R. Horton's site, and another is marked Final Opportunities.
The schools a builder lists as nearby are not your zoned schools. Check the exact address with CCSD.

cards.note: Nine phases selling in Heartland at Tule Springs, its gated master plan in 89084. Heartland Trails townhomes from the $333s, two-story homes at Cottages, Bay, and Falls, single-story Grove and Manor from the $520s, and six bedroom Heartland Summit from the $721s. Serenity is coming soon.

part2_sections.h2: Where is North Las Vegas, and what is close by?

blocks.lede: North Las Vegas covers the north side of the valley. The newest building runs along and north of the 215 Beltway, from the Tule Springs area east toward I-15.

ul: Getting around: the 215 Beltway, I-15, and I-11 all serve the city. Sandstone sits right at North 5th Street and the 215. Lennar places Heritage Square close to the 215 and Solara close to I-15.
Commute: drive your route at the hour you would actually drive it before you commit, especially if you work on the south end of the valley.
Nellis Air Force Base: Lennar markets Meridian, on the east side, for its closeness to the base.
Tule Springs Fossil Beds National Monument: Heartland markets trail access and views of the monument, and Sandstone plans a new trailhead to it.
Parks: Sandstone plans more than 12 acres of parks, Heartland has community parks and dog parks, and Tropical Breeze Park near Grandview has a splash pad and walking trails.
Golf: Aliante Golf Club, which D.R. Horton places 1 mile from Heartland Trails.

blocks.p: Every community on this page lists its city as North Las Vegas. That is its own city, separate from the City of Las Vegas, so check the city on any address you find online before you assume it belongs here.

part2_sections.h2: What should you know before buying new in North Las Vegas?

blocks.lede: The starting prices here are easy to like. A few things are worth checking before you fall for a model.

ul: Know what the low price buys. Most new homes under $400,000 here are gated two-story townhomes. Single-story detached homes at Heartland start in the $520s.
Get the HOA and SID in writing. The builder pages do not clearly publish either one. Ask for the HOA budget and look up the parcel with the Clark County Treasurer.
Ask about every association. Some Tule Springs area homes pay a master and a sub-master HOA.
Move fast, but not blind. Two Heartland phases have already dropped off D.R. Horton's site, and Heartland Falls 3 Car is marked Final Opportunities.
Expect construction for years. Sandstone opened in September 2026 with more than 1,500 homes still to come, and two of its neighborhoods are not open yet.
Visit near Nellis at different times. If you are looking at the east side, like Meridian, drive by in the morning and evening to hear the area for yourself.
Nearby is not zoned. The schools on a builder's page are nearby, not always the ones your address is zoned for.

part2_sections.h2: Why bring your own agent to a North Las Vegas model home?

blocks.lede: The friendly person at the sales desk works for the builder. Their job is to sell that builder's homes at that builder's price.

blocks.p: In North Las Vegas you might be comparing a Lennar townhome, a D.R. Horton phase that is almost sold out, and a KB Home in a master plan that just opened, each with different lot premiums, HOAs, and possible SIDs. Having someone on your side who lines those up costs you nothing, because the builder pays the buyer agent commission either way. The one rule: most builders require your agent to be registered on your very first visit. Here is what having your own agent actually changes.

faq: What is the cheapest new construction in North Las Vegas right now?
Heritage Square by Lennar, with gated townhomes from $313,490 as of September 16, 2026. KB Home lists its upcoming Meadows townhomes at Sandstone in the low $300s, coming fall 2026.
Are there new single-story homes in North Las Vegas?

Yes. D.R. Horton's Heartland Grove has single-story homes from 1,839 square feet starting in the $520s, and Heartland Manor Phase IV has single-story homes from 2,300 to 2,754 square feet starting in the $601s. KB Home's Briscoe also has one-story plans, but it is closing out.
What is Sandstone at Tule Springs?

It is KB Home's new North Las Vegas master plan at North 5th Street and the 215 Beltway. It opened September 4, 2026, with more than 1,500 homes planned across four neighborhoods. Landings starts in the high $300s and Reserves in the mid $400s.
Which builders are building in North Las Vegas?

D.R. Horton, KB Home, and Lennar all have North Las Vegas communities confirmed on their own websites as of September 16, 2026. Other builders may also sell here, so ask me for the current list before you tour.
Do new homes in North Las Vegas have SID fees?

Some may. A SID payment shows up on your property tax bill, not in your HOA, and the builder pages I checked did not publish one. Look up the parcel on the Clark County Treasurer site and read the public offering statement before you sign.
How much are HOA fees for new homes in North Las Vegas?

It depends on the community, and D.R. Horton, KB Home, and Lennar did not clearly publish HOA amounts on the pages I checked. Some Tule Springs area homes also pay a sub-master association, so ask for every HOA amount in writing.
What schools serve Heartland at Tule Springs?
D.R. Horton lists Vincent L. Triggs Elementary, Anthony Saville Middle, and Legacy High as nearby schools. Nearby does not always mean zoned, so confirm your exact address on the CCSD zoning search.
Is there new 55 and better construction in North Las Vegas?
None of the communities confirmed on builder sites for this page are age restricted. If a 55 and better community is what you want, reach out and I will check what is selling across the valley.
